title: Erasing one unary scratch cell
statement: For natural numbers $q$ and $j$, let the unary scratch tape of length $q$ with its first $j$ cells cleared have a $1$ at integer position $z$ exactly when $j\le z<q$, and be blank elsewhere. Blanking position $j$ on this tape yields the unary scratch tape of length $q$ with its first $j+1$ cells cleared.
replaced:
For all $q$ and $j$, blanking cell $j$ of the unary scratch tape of length
$q$ with $j$ cells already cleared yields the scratch tape with $j+1$ cells
cleared.
